##### Project general facts

Silawana is a boutique hillside investment complex in Ubud, Bali, developed by EVDEkimi — a company specializing in transforming properties into income-generating rental assets.
The project features a limited collection of private villas, positioned in a cascading layout with unobstructed views over a river canyon and rice terraces. This format combines strong lifestyle appeal with high rental performance, targeting a premium guest segment.
All units are delivered fully furnished and ready for operation, with professional management in place from launch.
The investment model is clear and structured:
 — 10% ROI secured in the contract (Year 1)
 — ~12% projected annual return based on operating performance
Flexible purchase options are available, including full payment and a staged installment plan (40/30/20/10).

##### Parking

On-site shared parking with convenient access for residents and guests.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the hills of Ubud, this exceptional location places residents in Bali’s most stable and attractive real estate market. Unlike the island’s busy coastal areas, Ubud’s development remains less dense due to land constraints and cultural heritage preservation, making jungle and rice-field views a finite and precious asset. The area is shared by world-class resorts such as Four Seasons and Kamandalu, yet Silawana offers these same panoramic canyon views in a private, intimate setting.

The location is distinguished by its central connectivity and serene atmosphere. Just a short drive from Ubud Palace, the complex offers direct routes to Kintamani, breathtaking waterfalls, and the airport, all free from tourist traffic and congestion. Ubud is the image of Bali seen in global media and travel imagery, renowned for its spiritual energy, vibrant arts scene, and lush natural beauty.

For those seeking a residence that embodies tranquility, culture, and investment stability, Ubud delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of finite natural views, cultural heritage, and growing international demand makes it one of Bali’s most desirable addresses. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of Bali, serene, inspiring and effortlessly connected.
